headword: {共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}
reading: きょうどうけんきゅう

definitions.explanation: Research carried out jointly by two or more people, institutions, or companies working together toward a common goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
